assertions.description: The Notification API exists with the requireInteraction member (the field that becomes advisory for attributed macOS app notifications) on its prototype.
The requireInteraction dictionary member is reflected on instances: what the page passes is what it reads back (the OS may still override display style — that part is deliberately unobservable).
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (!('Notification' in window)) return false; try { if (Notification.permission === 'granted') { const n = new Notification('conformance-probe', { requireInteraction: true, silent: true }); const ok = n.requireInteraction === true; n.close(); return ok; } return 'requireInteraction' in Notification.prototype; } catch (e) { return 'requireInteraction' in Notification.prototype; } })()

assertions.description: The Badging API surface the macOS gate applies to: navigator.setAppBadge and navigator.clearAppBadge are functions.
setAppBadge/clearAppBadge return promises that settle (resolution deliberately does not reveal whether a badge rendered — the gate is silent by design).
assertions.test: (async()=>{ if (typeof navigator.setAppBadge !== 'function') return false; try { const p = navigator.setAppBadge(1); if (!(p instanceof Promise)) return false; await p.catch(() => {}); await navigator.clearAppBadge().catch(() => {}); return true; } catch (e) { return false; } })()

assertions.description: The notifications permission (the gate's key) is queryable through the Permissions API with a valid state.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ if (!navigator.permissions?.query) return false; try { const p = await navigator.permissions.query({ name: 'notifications' }); return ['granted', 'denied', 'prompt'].includes(p.state); } catch (e) { return false; } })()

assertions.description: The installed-app context is detectable via the display-mode media feature (matchMedia parses it and reports a boolean).
assertions.test: (()=>{ const mq = matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)'); return typeof mq.matches === 'boolean' && mq.media.includes('display-mode'); })()
